question.text: In the distribution stage, structuring income to stay within lower tax brackets is an example of:

answer.text: Tax planning or tax-efficient withdrawal strategy

explanation.text: The Logic: Using tax-free income, income adjustments, capital-gains treatment where applicable, and deductions to stay within a lower tax bracket is legitimate tax planning at the distribution stage. The Trap: Tax planning is legal (Option B); tax evasion (Option A) is illegal. The distinction is between structuring affairs within the law and breaching tax obligations. Note: The workbook frames distribution-stage tax strategy around using tax-free income, adjusting income sources, leveraging capital-gains treatment where applicable, and applying available deductions to remain in a lower bracket.
